reasoning: The evaluation found 3 major LLM fidelity defects, including a broken numbered list that restarts numbering, missing hyperlinks for text that was styled as links in the source, and visual duplication of an attendance sheet on page 2. Based on the count-based routing thresholds, 1 to 5 major defects require routing to human review. The programmatic signals corroborate the missing hyperlinks.

concerns.analysis: The source document contains a continuous numbered list spanning from page 3 to page 4 (items 1 through 10). In the JSON output, the list is broken across pages. While this is an expected page-break extraction artifact, the list items on page 4 ('5. ESInet Update', '6. NMAC Update', etc.) have had their explicit numbers stripped from the text and are placed in a new ordered list object without a 'start' attribute. As a result, this second half of the list will render starting at number 1 instead
